overview.short: Pualreng Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary in the Kolasib district in the Indian state of Mizoram.
overview.description: Pualreng Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary in the Kolasib district in the Indian state of Mizoram. It was notified on 29 July 2004 and it covers approximately 50 km² of tropical evergreen and semi-evergreen forest in the northeastern hill ranges.

items.note: Zokhawthiang is a village in the Darlawn Community Development Block in the Aizawl district, Mizoram, India and the nearest town is Darlawn, located about 32 km (20 mi) away. According to the 2011 Census, Zokhawthiang had a population of 955 people living in 156 households, with a literacy rate of 97.27%.

Sunhluchhip is a village in the Darlawn Community Development Block in the Aizawl district, Mizoram, India and the nearest town is Darlawn, located about 24 km away. According to the 2011 Census, Sunhluchhip had a population of 568 people living in 101 households, with a literacy rate of 97.82%.
